text:
Carlos: Traveling to NYC next Thu, staying near Grand Central. Looking for a quick noodle spot for 5 at ~7pm. Prefer something not too loud and with veg options. Any recs?
Aisha: Totto Ramen is great but usually lines. If you want spice, Ichiran is solid but it's solo seating.
Ben: For groups, Ivan Ramen in the east village is walkable and has veg-friendly options.
Yuko: There's a small spot, Momo Noodles, right by Lexington that does yakisoba and veg dumplings  cheaper and quick.
Priya: Quick poll: react :one: Totto Ramen  :two: Ivan Ramen  :three: Momo Noodles.
Aisha: :one: (but expect a wait)
Ben: :two:
Yuko: :three: :thumbsup: (easy for groups)
Carlos: Leaning Momo for speed. Can someone call ahead to check tables for 5? I might be delayed by a meeting. Also one person is gluten-free.
Priya: I can call. If Momo can't do GF, I'll try Ivan.
Priya: Called Momo Noodles: they can take a reservation for 5 at 7pm, Conf# MN-557. They said GF noodles available on request and they can do two veggie dumpling plates.
Priya: Pasted confirmation:
```
Momo Noodles
Lexington Ave near 44th St
Thu 7:00pm party of 5
Conf: MN-557
Notes: GF noodles available; veg dumplings x2
```
Carlos: Amazing, thank you! Adding to calendar.
calendar-bot: Event added to #team-calendar "Thu NYC: Momo Noodles 7pm".
lunch-bot: Tip: Momo is cash + card, but cards have a small processing fee. Street parking limited after 6pm. :money_with_wings: :oncoming_taxi:
Ben: I'll meet y'all straight from the office. Thanks Priya!
Yuko: See you Thursday :)
